thread:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — inference-serving (eu-west-1) showing elevated 5xx rate over the last 3m. Affected: hosted text-gen endpoints. Threshold hit. Runbook: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx. Primary oncall @maria please ack.

maria: Ack, seeing the alert. Jumping in now. Any ongoing deploys or config pushes in eu-west-1?

aj: Not from my side. CI shows a canary finishing ~10m ago but no rollout active. I can check the canary logs.

lee: I rotated traffic to fallback model variant at 11:02 UTC for a subset of requests earlier today (manual test). That was unrelated but might be interfering with metrics aggregation.

maria: Good to know. First priorities: 1) confirm scope/customer impact, 2) get a mitigation (rollback or traffic split), 3) set escalation timeline. Noah can you pull SLO graphs and top 5 error traces?

noah: On it. SLO dashboard: 5xx spike concentrated on /v1/generate, median latency +120ms, error histogram shows a surge in `kv cache miss` followed by internal timeout in the runtime. Top traces attached in the dashboard.

maria: That points at KV cache or runtime memory pressure. Quick mitigation: reduce batch size + enable aggressive prefix caching bypass to lower memory footprint. I'll patch config on the canary first.

aj: If you patch batch_size, be prepared for throughput dip. Are we ok to trade throughput for stability? Also, if ack window fails, pager policy says escalate to secondary after 5m.

maria: Yes tradeoff ok for now. I'll apply to canary and watch error rate. If stable for 5m, we can roll to primary pool.

ops-bot: Note: Pager policy reminder — Primary oncall gets page first. If no ack in 5 minutes escalate to Secondary. After 15 minutes without resolution escalate to `sre-leads` and page `support-lead` for customer comms. For Sev2+ incidents, page Product PM. (This is the configured escalation matrix.)

lee: FYI I'm scheduled to become primary at 17:45 UTC, there's a 15m staggered swap where aj is still secondary until 18:00. That creates a small overlap but also a 3m window where no one is seated if someone's out. Maria — if you need coverage after you leave at 17:30 can you hand to me earlier?

maria: I can stay until 18:00 if needed, or handoff early to lee. I'll stay until we get a stable 10m window. Documenting actions in the incident board: https://incidents.internal/board/INC-2024-042.

noah: Mitigation applied to canary: `batch_size=8 -> 4`, `kv_cache_eviction=aggressive`. Errors dropped from 5.2% to 1.1% in 2 mins on canary traffic. Monitoring multiregion now.

maria: Good. Continue monitoring. If errors fall <1% across primary pool for 10m, we mark as mitigated and do postmortem. If error returns or latency spikes >250ms for >5m, escalate to `sre-leads` immediately and page `support-lead` and `product-pm`.

aj: Quick checklist snippet for oncall to follow (copy to personal notes):
```
1) Ack alert
2) Check dashboard + traces
3) Confirm active deploys
4) Apply minimal mitigation to canary
5) Wait 5-10m, if improvement schedule rollout
6) If no ack escalate to Secondary after 5m
7) If customer-impacting (>1% requests, or >10% for high-value customers) page Support + PM
```

lee: I'll be primary after 17:45 UTC and will watch for followups. If anyone needs late handoff, ping me directly. Also tagging `sre-lead-bot` for timeline capture.

sre-lead-bot: Incident INC-2024-042 noted. Severity set to Sev2 due to sustained errors >1% affecting hosted API. Timeline auto-capturing. Notify `sre-leads` if mitigation not complete by 17:55 UTC.

maria: Handing off active watch to lee at 17:58 UTC if all clear. Leaving runbook pointer and exact commands I ran in the incident board. Thanks team.

lee: Ack and monitoring. If rate creeps back up I'll escalate per policy. Closing thread for now and moving notes to postmortem queue. :thumbsup:
